pages.text: The sky was dark. "Rain coming." Mom came out with a shovel.
From above, Dingding looked down. Water-filled patches reflected sky; drained ones were earth-colored. "Today I will protect the fields."
Mom opened the top patch. Water rushed into the side ditch. "Done. All drained."
"You must check the other patches." Mom shouldered the shovel and turned. "All the same. I am busy."
Mom went home with a basket on her head.
Dingding looked down the fields. Two middle patches still reflected sky.
Raindrops began. Circles kept appearing in the sky-reflecting patches.
Dingding went to Mom. "The sky is still in two middle patches!"
Mom took the shovel again and opened both, one after the other. Rush, rush!
Rain poured. No field overflowed. Far below, Mr. Ming raised both hands.
